name: karni-approvals
summary: Maker-checker approvals for Karni: a second person approves high-value changes before they are written, with a queue, an API and an audit trail. Karni is an open-source Django + React framework for building with AI coding agents. Your agent writes only your domain. The API, admin, permissions and React screens come from a package you upgrade, not code it rewrites in each project. One rule set covers Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot. The build fails when an agent hand-writes what Karni ships.
